I'm a data analyst who thinks in patterns — a skill sharpened long before I touched a dataset.

My analytical, research, and problem-solving skills were built studying Soil Science and Land Management Resources at Obafemi Awolowo University. Reading terrain and resource data taught me to look for patterns and test what the evidence actually shows — an instinct that translates directly into working with any dataset.

Today I work hands-on with Excel and Power BI — cleaning data, analyzing it, and building dashboards that turn raw numbers into insight across industries like e-commerce, supply chain, healthcare, and entertainment. I enjoy transforming raw data into meaningful insights that support informed decisions and solve real-world problems.

Services

What I can help with

P

Data cleaning & preparation

Messy spreadsheets, inconsistent formatting, missing values — cleaned and structured with Excel and Power Query so the data is ready to analyze.

A

Data analysis

Digging into a dataset to find the trends, patterns, and outliers that matter — turning rows of numbers into answers to real questions.

B

Dashboard & report design

Interactive Power BI dashboards that make performance visible at a glance — clear enough for a five-minute meeting, deep enough for a full review.

V

Data visualization

Charts and visuals that communicate, not decorate — reports people understand without needing a walkthrough.

T

Performance tracking systems

Simple, repeatable systems for monitoring performance over time, built on the same analytical rigor developed studying land and resource data.
